# Invite Link

Invite Link is an India-first interactive digital invitation maker at https://invitelink.shop.

## Product

- Free: basic personalized invitation with Invite Link credit and one end sponsor.
- Essential: ₹399 one-time for full standard customization, custom slug and no third-party ads.
- Premium: ₹999 one-time for premium interactions, media, analytics and no Invite Link branding.
- Bespoke: custom invitation design from ₹4,999.

## Core pages

- Templates: https://invitelink.shop/templates
- Pricing: https://invitelink.shop/pricing
- Create: https://invitelink.shop/create
- FAQ: https://invitelink.shop/faq
- Contact: https://invitelink.shop/contact

Personalized invitation and dashboard URLs are not intended for search indexing.
